items.title: FP16 GEMM Optimization on AMD RDNA™ 3 and RDNA™ 4 Architectures
items.summary: In this blog you will learn how to write a fast FP16 GEMM kernel for AMD RDNA™ 3 and RDNA™ 4 GPUs, one optimization at a time. You will see which techniques pay off on each architecture, why some help one and hurt the other, and how to measure the effect of every change in time, registers, and LDS, so you can apply the same approach to your own kernels. This is Part 1 of a two-part series. Part 2 will port the final kernel from this post to FP8 on RDNA 4.
